slides.texte_overlay:
How to be attractive
without trying to be
1. Take care of your health first. Good sleep, real food, regular training. Energy and a clear face are more attractive than any outfit.
2. Listen like it matters. Put the phone away, look at people, remember what they say. Full attention is rare and magnetic.
3. Keep your word. On time, reliable, consistent. People feel safe around a man they can count on. Reliability is attractive.
4. Be kind without an audience. Help a stranger, thank the cleaner, hold the door. Real kindness doesn't need to be seen.
5. Stay curious. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and having new ideas to share makes me better company.
slides.texte_sophia: 5. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Having new ideas to share makes me better company.

slides.texte_overlay: 6. Have calm confidence. No need to prove anything or win every argument. Ease with yourself is quietly attractive.
Attraction isn't a performance. It's what happens when you build a life and a character worth being around. Start today.
